title: Standing work, a test: iron at Ironhollow Echo Ejecta (beyond the border) into storage at The Experiment
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-17 03:11 UTC (orders.log ENT-025, block ZERO: iron for the reserve; rule F13: a test with one ship and an empty hold). The field read 94,493 iron (richness 26) and 100,000 copper (25) at about 01:20 UTC, and grew back 275 iron an hour over 28 hours (hive.py refill); it lies in the same system as Ironhollow Fading Signal, one jump from The Experiment, where seven miners gather under a guard of Military (requests.log ENT-181). A combat ship of the faction tagged BUSY was seen at this place at 2026-11-16 23:06 UTC, not in combat (table met). One ship until its first RESULT line is read. 2026-11-17 05:52 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 1 -> 25. 2026-11-17 07:12 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-029, task 4 a): floor {"iron_ore": 30000} -> 20,000 iron, because the game says a depleted deposit refills gradually in proportion to its capacity (game/rules/13-not-stated.md, from mining.md), and our reads agree: Hamal grew back about 360 iron an hour at 31,000, Ironhollow Fading Signal 413 at 52,551, Echo Ejecta 312 near 97,000 (hive.py refill, read.db readings); a higher floor buys no faster regrowth, only a stock left for later, and iron is short 298,708 (the tool stock, view=reserve, 07:03 UTC). lift_to 25: 96,911 iron at 06:46 UTC; 4 miner runs 03:00 to 07:00 UTC gave 172 ore a run of 55 minutes (richness 26). 2026-11-17 11:32 UTC (Zero): lift_to 25 -> 35. Schedar Belt (29,315 iron at 10:15 UTC) and Ironhollow Fading Signal (29,682 at 10:40 UTC) reach their floor of 20,000 within about two hours at the ships on them (table fields), and the ice drains closed at 11:11 UTC: the places their ships take until the next turn, widened by fill.py only while ships wait. Its runs of 07:00 to 11:30 UTC by miners: 11, median 174 ore in 45 minutes, -180 cr (data/routes/runs.jsonl); with Fading Signal at its floor the two Ironhollow belts stay near the 45 ships Military plans its guard for.
